content:
The Laredo Police Department is warning drivers to avoid the intersection of Shiloh Drive and Las Cruces Drive, saying the intersection is flooded, according to KGNS.

The warning was issued Sunday, November 8. Police did not state what caused the flooding at the intersection, and no road closure was announced. No injuries, stranded vehicles, or other details were reported.

The warning comes as a flood watch remains in effect for Webb County and the surrounding area until noon Monday, with heavy rain moving through South Texas through the night.

Drivers are urged to avoid the Shiloh and Las Cruces area and to never drive through flooded roadways.

Source: KGNS, November 8, 2026.

title: Laredo police warn drivers to avoid flooded Shiloh and Las Cruces intersection
